sol-3-1.summary: ReferenceList and HarvestedReferenceList accept closing flags that contradict their keywords; merged seats sol-3-1 and fable-3-1.
sol-3-1.fix: Add a shared annotated schema check equating closing with ClosingKeyword membership and apply it explicitly to ReferenceList and HarvestedReferenceList; field spreading alone does not inherit whole-object checks. Preserve field annotations, encoded shape and parser outputs. Reject both crossed keyword/flag combinations for both schemas and retain valid/parser cases in ClosingList.test.ts. Keep schema-derived round-trip properties in ClosingList.property.test.ts with arbitrary support for consistent pairs. Central codemod owns deviation recording; do not edit Port notes, ledger or repository configuration.

sol-3-2.summary: IssueReference and HarvestedReferenceList accept equal or reversed start/end offsets that cannot identify a harvested match.
sol-3-2.fix: Add annotated whole-object end > start checks to IssueReference in IssueReferences.ts and HarvestedReferenceList in ClosingList.ts. Preserve fields, annotations, encoded shape and parser outputs. Add equal/reversed rejection cases and real-harvest acceptance cases in IssueReferences.test.ts and ClosingList.test.ts. Retain both schema round-trip property suites with schema-derived arbitrary support for ordered spans and consistent harvested-list flags. Do not weaken schemas or unrelated upstream assertions. Central codemod owns deviation recording; do not edit Port notes, ledger or repository configuration.
